lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਓੁਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: har har kripaa dhaar gur melahu gur miliai har oumaahaa raam ||3||
lines.translation: O Lord, Har, Har, be merciful to me, and lead me to meet the Guru; meeting the Guru, a sincere yearning for the Lord wells up in me. ||3||
Praise Him, the unfathomable and inaccessible Lord.
Each and every moment, sing the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਧਾਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਦਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਿ ਓੁਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੪॥੨॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: mo kau dhaar kripaa mileeai gur daate har naanak bhagat oumaahaa raam ||4||2||8||
lines.translation: Be merciful, and meet me, O Guru, Great Giver; Nanak yearns for the Lord's devotional worship. ||4||2||8||
Jaitsree, Fourth Mehl:
With love and energetic affection, praise the Lord, the storehouse of Nectar.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਭੀਨਾ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: man raam naam bheenaa lai laahaa ||
lines.translation: My mind is drenched with the Lord's Name, and so it earns this profit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਓੁਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: khin khin bhagat karah din raatee guramat bhagat oumaahaa raam ||1||
lines.translation: Each and every moment, worship Him in devotion, day and night; through the Guru's Teachings, sincere love and devotion well up. ||1||
Chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਜੀਤਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tan jeet sabad lai laahaa ||
lines.translation: Conquering mind and body, I have earned the profit of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਵਸਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਓਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: guramat pa(n)ch doot vas aavahi man tan har omaahaa raam ||2||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, the five demons are over-powered, and the mind and body are filled with a sincere yearning for the Lord. ||2||
The Name is a jewel - chant the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਸਦਾ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har gun gaai sadaa lai laahaa ||
lines.translation: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and forever earn this profit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਧੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਓੁਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: deen daiaal kripaa kar maadho har har naam oumaahaa raam ||3||
lines.translation: O Lord, merciful to the meek, be kind to me, and bless me with sincere longing for the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||
Meditate on the Lord of the world - meditate within your mind.
The Lord of the Universe, Har, Har, is the only real profit in this world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਵਡੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਿ ਓਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੪॥੩॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: dhan dhan vade thaakur prabh mere jap naanak bhagat omaahaa raam ||4||3||9||
lines.translation: Blessed, blessed, is my Great Lord and Master God; O Nanak, meditate on Him, worship Him with sincere love and devotion. ||4||3||9||
Jaitsree, Fourth Mehl:
He Himself is the Yogi, and the way throughout the ages.
The Fearless Lord Himself is absorbed in Samaadhi.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਆਪੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਓੁਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aape hee aap aap varatai aape naam oumaahaa raam ||1||
lines.translation: He Himself, all by Himself, is all-pervading; He Himself blesses us with sincere love for the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||
He Himself is the lamp, and the Light pervading all the worlds.
He Himself is the True Guru; He Himself churns the ocean.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮਥਿ ਮਥਿ ਤਤੁ ਕਢਾਏ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਓੁਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: aape math math tat kadhaae jap naam ratan oumaahaa raam ||2||
lines.translation: He Himself churns it, churning up the essence; meditating on the jewel of the Naam, sincere love comes to the surface. ||2||
O my companions, let us meet and join together, and sing His Glorious Praises.
As Gurmukh, chant the Naam, and earn the profit of the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੀ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਓੁਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: har har bhagat driRee man bhaaee har har naam oumaahaa raam ||3||
lines.translation: Devotional worship of the Lord, Har, Har, has been implanted within me; it is pleasing to my mind. The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, brings a sincere love. ||3||
He Himself is supremely wise, the greatest King.
As Gurmukh, purchase the merchandise of the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਓੁਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: har har daat karahu prabh bhaavai gun naanak naam oumaahaa raam ||4||4||10||
lines.translation: O Lord God, Har, Har, bless me with such a gift, that Your Glorious Virtues seem pleasing to me; Nanak is filled with sincere love and yearning for the Lord. ||4||4||10||
Jaitsree, Fourth Mehl:
Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and associating with the Guru,
the Gurmukh gathers in the merchandise of the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਓੁਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har har kripaa dhaar madhusoodan mil satasa(n)g oumaahaa raam ||1||
lines.translation: O Lord, Har, Har, Destroyer of demons, have mercy upon me; bless me with a sincere yearning to join the Sat Sangat. ||1||
Let me hear with my ears the Banis, the Hymns, in praise of the Lord;
be merciful, and let me meet the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹ ਗੁਣ ਬੋਲਹ ਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਜਪਿ ਓੁਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: gun gaavah gun bolah baanee har gun jap oumaahaa raam ||2||
lines.translation: I sing His Glorious Praises, I speak the Bani of His Word; chanting His Glorious Praises, a sincere yearning for the Lord wells up. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਵਰਤ ਜਗ ਪੁੰਨ ਤੋੁਲਾਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh teerath varat jag pu(n)n toulaahaa ||
lines.translation: I have tried visiting all the sacred shrines of pilgrimage, fasting, ceremonial feasts and giving to charities.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨ ਪੁਜਹਿ ਪੁਜਾਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam na pujahi pujaahaa ||
lines.translation: They do not measure up to the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਤੁਲੁ ਤੋਲੁ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਪਿ ਓੁਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: har har atul tol at bhaaree guramat jap oumaahaa raam ||3||
lines.translation: The Lord's Name is unweighable, utterly heavy in weight; through the Guru's Teachings, a sincere yearning to chant the Name has welled up in me. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh karam dharam har naam japaahaa ||
lines.translation: All good karma and righteous living are found in meditation on the Lord's Name.
It washes away the stains of sins and mistakes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਹੋਹੁ ਜਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਓਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: deen daiaal hohu jan oopar dehu naanak naam omaahaa raam ||4||5||11||
lines.translation: Be merciful to meek, humble Nanak; bless him with sincere love and yearning for the Lord. ||4||5||11||
